item.title: CVE-2026-133117 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | WebToffee Product Feed before 2.4.4 for WordPress contains a use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the URL-cron signature check by computing a valid hash using the publicly known constant salt embedded in the plugin source. Attackers can send forged GET requests with attacker-controlled parameters to the unauthenticated init-hooked endpoint to repeatedly trigger product-feed generation, causing CPU/database resource exhaustion and overwriting of the generated feed file.

item.title: CVE-2026-87956 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | When Private data source connect (PDC) or a secure SOCKS proxy is used, the MQTT data source plugin does not apply TLS to broker connections for the tls, ssl, tcps, mqtts and mqtt+ssl schemes. The configured TLS settings are ignored, and the broker username and password are sent unencrypted on the hop between the proxy and the broker. The server certificate is not verified, and a configured client certificate is not sent.
